clearBoardConfirmation: Do you want to remove all columns and records ?
deleteColumnConfirmation: Do you want to delete column ?
deleteRecordConfirmation: Do you want to delete record ?
deleteAllRecordConfirmation: Do you want to delete all records ?
title: Title
noCompletedRecord: Stamp a card as done, or drag it here.
snapshotHint: A snapshot is saved on this computer every 30 minutes and before every import, clear or restore (latest 20). It does not replace exporting a backup file.
importConfirmReplace: Replace the current board with {{columns}} columns / {{records}} records from the file? A snapshot will be saved first.
importConfirmMerge: Merge {{columns}} columns / {{records}} records from the file? For the same card, the more recently modified one wins. A snapshot will be saved first.
restoreConfirm: Replace the current board with the snapshot from {{time}}? The current board will be saved as a snapshot first.
importFailed: Import failed: this is not a valid backup file.
upToDate: You are on the latest version.
updateOffline: Cannot reach the update server (offline?). Your board still works offline.
updateFailed: Update failed. Nothing was changed; the current version keeps working.
updateHint: Only downloads when you press Update now. A snapshot is saved first, and your data is upgraded automatically if the new version changes the data format. Backing up first is recommended.
updateSingleFileHint: This is the single-file version and cannot update itself. Back up first, then download the new file and replace the old one.
backupNewerSchema: This backup was made by a newer version (data format is newer). Please update the app first, then import again.
secureHint: The board is compressed (deflate) and encrypted (AES-256-GCM) into plain text you can paste into email, notes or chat. Importing needs the same password.
securePasswordWarning: The password is not stored. If you forget it the backup cannot be opened.
securePasswordShort: Password must be at least {{n}} characters
secureCopyManually: Could not copy automatically. Click the text and press Ctrl+C.
secureWrongPassword: Wrong password, or the text / timestamp was modified
activityHint: Hover a square to see that day's activity
activitySource: Activity = adding, editing, stamping, moving or deleting cards. Days before recording started are estimated from card created / modified / completed times. The log is stored only in this browser.
boardTitleHint: Double-click to rename (saved on this device only)
deleteColumnWarning: Delete the column "{{title}}"? Its {{count}} cards (including done ones) will be deleted too.
deleteColumnIrreversible: A snapshot is saved first; you can restore it from Backup → Snapshots if needed.
